push_quiz_to_hub: run the script to push all JSON quiz files in the data directory to the Hugging Face Hub as private datasets
create_dataset_from_json: create a HuggingFace Dataset from a list of quiz question dictionaries loaded from a JSON file
push_dataset_to_hub: push a HuggingFace Dataset to a private repository under the agents-course organization
load_quiz_json: load quiz question data from a JSON file in the data directory using json.load
generate_repo_id: generate a Hugging Face Hub repository ID from the JSON file stem with the _quiz suffix
